A little structure, none of the fuss

Food logging that fits between everything else.

QikCal keeps the everyday loop short: choose what you ate, adjust it to your plate, and get back to your day.

A

Find your food

Search the QikCal Food Library, or add a food yourself when you need a simple personal entry.

Choose a reported serving or enter grams. Calories and available nutrients scale with the amount you log.

C

Look back, gently

See your seven-day pattern, edit a log, or share a recap when you choose. Nothing is posted for you.

Your diary stays yours

Private by design. Useful offline.

Your diary is stored on your iPhone. QikCal has no account, advertising SDK, analytics SDK or server diary. Your food log is excluded from device backups, and you can export or delete it in Settings.

Offline calorie tracking with no subscription ↗

Food energy is an estimate from the QikCal Food Library. Values can be missing or vary by food and preparation; QikCal is a diary, not medical advice. For nutrition guidance about a medical condition, consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional.

The offline iPhone catalogue contains 159,088 food records. Listed measures are available for most foods, and you can also enter a weight in grams. Values are estimates per 100 g, and ingredients or preparation can change the result.
